appName.description: Name of the MuleSoft application to upgrade.

environment.description: Anypoint Platform environment to upgrade the application in.

jiraTicketId.description: Optional. Jira ticket ID to link this migration to. When present, progress and decision comments are posted to it and PR/Slack notifications include a link. When absent, the job still runs end-to-end; a migration ticket is auto-created when Jira auto-create is enabled, otherwise Jira integration is simply skipped.

approvedChangePlan.description: Optional, audit-only. The human-approved plan from assess_app, recorded on the job record for traceability. The upgrade worker re-runs assessment internally and drives the actual edits from its own freshly-computed fileEdits, so this value is NOT trusted and omitting it does not change the upgrade outcome.

branch.description: Optional. Explicit branch to upgrade for this request. Highest precedence — overrides the registry default and the repository's discovered default branch.

owner.description: Optional GitHub owner/org override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

repo.description: Optional GitHub repository name override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

appPath.description: Optional path to the Mule module within the repo (e.g. "." for repo root).

orgId.description: Optional Anypoint organization ID override (used only when the app is not in the registry).
